name: Cloudflare Clef
description: Serves Cloudflare's open-weight Clef and Clef-flash decision models on Workers AI, returning a probability for every option of typed questions about a text, JSON, or image state.

skills.name: Typed Decision Questions
skills.description: Answers up to 64 noul, choice, or score questions per request about a given state, returning a probability for every allowed option.

skills.name: Image State Input
skills.description: Accepts up to four embedded PNG, JPEG, or WebP images placed before the text state, so decisions can draw on screenshots or photos.

skills.name: Clef-flash Model
skills.description: Runs the same question schema on Clef-flash, a 9B model with a lower per-token price than the 27B Clef, for latency-critical decisions.

skills.name: Open Weights Download
skills.description: Downloads the Clef and Clef-flash weights from Hugging Face under an Apache 2.0 license to run the decision models on your own hardware.
